name: She Is My Precious
source:
This story is your story, still hoping for a life you've planned to live.
But when an old hope fades, a new one takes it's place.
Will the past haunt your future, or will it nourish it? What will be left when you have overcome it all?​
translation:
这个故事是你的故事，你仍然希望过上你计划过的生活。
但当旧的希望破灭时，新的希望就会取而代之。
过去会困扰你的未来，还是会滋养你的未来？当你克服这一切之后，还会剩下什么？​
